application_status.label: 2026 Working Holiday intake is closed at the main metropolitan French missions checked
application_status.detail: Paris states its 2026 calendar is definitively closed and expects 2027 appointments to open during December 2026. Strasbourg, Lyon and Marseille also report 2026 Working Holiday intake closed/quota reached. Check your responsible mission for 2027 reopening details.

jurisdiction.label: Japanese mission responsible for your French consular area
jurisdiction.description: French applicants use the Japanese mission responsible for their consular area. French nationals living abroad and most DROM-COM fall under Paris; New Caledonia, French Polynesia and Wallis & Futuna are exceptions handled through Nouméa.
jurisdiction.ui_help: Choose the mission that covers your place of residence. Appointment availability and reopening dates vary by office.

options.label: Paris / green zone / abroad / most DROM-COM
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in France — Paris
options.mission_detail: Paris handles its green-zone jurisdiction plus French nationals living abroad and most DROM-COM. The 2026 Working Holiday calendar is closed; 2027 reopening is expected during December 2026.

options.label: Strasbourg jurisdiction
options.mission_detail: The Strasbourg consulate reports the 2026 Working Holiday quota reached and reopening from January 2027.

options.label: Lyon jurisdiction
options.mission_label: Consular Office of Japan in Lyon
options.mission_detail: Lyon reports 2026 Working Holiday appointments closed until further notice; check the office for reopening.

options.label: Marseille jurisdiction
options.mission_detail: Marseille reports its 2026 Working Holiday registration calendar closed; 2027 information will be published on its website.

options.label: New Caledonia / French Polynesia / Wallis & Futuna
options.mission_label: Consular Office of Japan in Nouméa
options.mission_detail: The Embassy guidance identifies these territories as depending on the Japanese consular office in Nouméa; check that office's current Working Holiday instructions.

document_checklist.title: Visa application form and photo
document_checklist.description: Use the current visa application form and attach a recent 45×35mm identity photo following mission instructions.

document_checklist.title: Valid French passport
document_checklist.description: Original passport plus photo-page copy; Paris requires at least two blank pages.

document_checklist.title: Financial proof
document_checklist.description: Paris currently requires €4,950 without a return ticket, or €3,100 plus a paid round-trip ticket and proof of the ticket debit; bank proof must be recent.

document_checklist.title: Recent medical certificate
document_checklist.description: Original medical certificate stating that you are in good health; Paris requires it to be no more than one month old.

document_checklist.title: Typed motivation letter
document_checklist.description: Explain your interest in Japan and why you are requesting the Working Holiday visa.

document_checklist.title: Typed detailed stay project
document_checklist.description: Use the required project format and describe concrete visits/activities showing the need for a long stay.

document_checklist.title: Typed CV
document_checklist.description: Prepare a typed CV; a personal format is accepted.

preparation_checklist.title: Check whether your mission is accepting Working Holiday applications
preparation_checklist.description: 2026 intake is currently closed at the major metropolitan missions verified; reopening timing for 2027 varies.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm your consular jurisdiction
preparation_checklist.description: Paris, Strasbourg, Lyon, Marseille and Nouméa have different jurisdiction and appointment arrangements.

preparation_checklist.title: Read your mission's current Working Holiday instructions
preparation_checklist.description: Document handling and appointment procedures can differ from the Paris baseline.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final source check
preparation_checklist.description: Re-check quota/calendar status and all required documents immediately before booking or lodging.
